about.title: Care Built on Experience, Trust and Heart
about.description: For over 12 years, Sisi Care has supported seniors and adults across Bellevue and the Eastside — guided by more than 20 years of hands-on care experience and a deep commitment to people.
story: Sisi Care began with a simple belief — every person deserves to age with dignity, comfort, and kindness in the place they call home.

With over 20 years of hands-on care experience, our founder saw the need for a more personal and compassionate approach to in-home care. In 2014, Sisi Care was established to bring that vision to life — providing reliable, high-quality care to seniors and families in Bellevue, the Eastside, and surrounding communities.

Today, we are proud to be a locally owned and trusted home care provider, known for our genuine care, strong relationships, and commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of the people we serve.
